FORT BENNING, GA, UNITED STATES - U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to the 197th and 198th Infantry Brigades conduct various stages of Infantry One Station Unit Training (OSUT) at the Maneuver Center of Excellence, Fort Benning, Georgia.

The training evolution captures the comprehensive transformation of civilians into lethal and disciplined Infantry Soldiers. The sequence highlights critical combat tasks including the initial 100-yard dash at Sand Hill, heavy weapons qualifications with the M240 machine gun and 60mm mortar systems, and M320 grenade launcher live-fire exercises. Modern tactical elements are integrated throughout the course, featuring Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) drone operations and urban terrain movement drills. The evolution culminates with the transformation of the trainees during their graduation ceremony at Inouye Field.

Payton King, Brandon Dorrill, Joy Edwards, Basil Lee
